title: Seagrove Beach "Whake Up" 172 Chivas Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf views- Steps from the public beach access- Complimentary beach setups each morning at Walton Dunes Beach Access include 4 beach chairs with 2 umbrellas (Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31)- Pinball machine and pop-a-shot games- Private Sand Volleyball Court- 9 adult bikes- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Elevator- Carriage house- Ultimate outdoor space: Huge private heated pool, splash deck, and sitting spa **Pool heating is available for this property from Oct 1-May 1 for $65 per day** The pool and spa are heated together.- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforters, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Whake Up is a beautiful 9-bedroom, 9-bathroom Main House and Carriage House in Seagrove Beach that collectively sleeps up to 34 guests. Enjoy laid-back days biking the Timpoochee Trail, paddleboarding along the shore, or searching for seashells. Guests will love the large private pool and short stroll to the beach!Bright hardwood floors and natural light welcome guests inside the roomy Main House. A TV and a pinball machine encourage lively nights in the first-floor game room. Venture outside to bask in the sunshine on the loungers surrounding the spacious pool and sitting spa. There are 2 guest bedrooms with private locker-style bathrooms. The first bedroom has a king bed and twin-over-twin bunk bed, while the second features a king bed and 6 twin beds. For last-minute guests, there’s a queen sleeper sofa.Head to the second floor to find the main living spaces, including a comfortable sitting area with a TV for relaxing after a day outdoors. The open-concept kitchen’s high-end appliances make cooking a breeze while visiting with friends perched along the 7-stool breakfast bar. There’s plenty of seating inside at the dining table’s 3 long benches and 2 chairs or dine alfresco at the covered balcony’s 2 patio tables. When night falls, retire to the 2 guest bedrooms with king beds and private bathrooms on this level.On the top floor, 2 guest bedrooms with king beds share a balcony with Gulf views, and there are 2 bunk rooms with queen-over-queen beds.A kitchen, living area with a queen sleeper sofa and 1 guest bedroom with a king bed are in the private Carriage House.Whake Up is the perfect setting for a delightful Seagrove Beach adventure. Leisurely explore with 9 complimentary adult bikes, a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle, and parking for 6 vehicles. For private beach access, follow the wooden boardwalk to the right of the driveway. Beachside Drive Public Beach Access and Walton Dunes Public Beach Access are also nearby. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 34):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Locker Style Bathroom with Triple Vanity and Double Shower Stalls- Guest Bedroom: King Bed and 6 Twin Beds, Private Locker Style Bathroom with Triple Vanity and Double Shower Stalls- Additional Sleeping Area: Queen Sleeper SofaSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Room: Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed, Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboCARRIAGE HOUSE:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Carriage House Living: Queen Sleeper Sofa*The garage is not for guest use.

body_text_excerpt: Destinations Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Watch Video Seagrove Beach "Whake Up" 172 Chivas Lane Santa Rosa Beach, FL Short Term Rental #STR-097450 Bedrooms 9 Beds 19 Sleeps 34 Full Baths 9 Half Baths 0 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf views - Steps from the public beach access - Complimentary beach setups each morning at Walton Dunes Beach Access include 4 beach chairs with 2 umbrellas (Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31) - Pinball machine and pop-a-shot games - Private Sand Volleyball Court - 9 adult bikes - 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - Elevator - Carriage house - Ultimate outdoor space: Huge private heated pool, splash deck, and sitting spa **Pool heating is available for this property from Oct 1-May 1 for $65 per day** The pool and spa are heated together. - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforters, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Whake Up is a beautiful 9-bedroom, 9-bathroom Main House and Carriage House in Seagrove Beach that collectively sleeps up to 34 guests. Enjoy laid-back days biking the Timpoochee Trail, paddleboarding along the shore, or searching for seashells. Guests will love the large private pool and short stroll to the beach! Bright hardwood floors and natural light welcome guests inside the roomy Main House. A TV and a pinball machine encourage lively nights in the first-floor game room. Venture outside to bask in the sunshine on the loungers surrounding the spacious pool and sitting spa. There are 2 guest bedrooms with private locker-style bathrooms. The first bedroom has a king bed and twin-over-twin bunk bed, while the second features a king bed and 6 twin beds. For last-minute guests, there’s a queen sleeper sofa. Head to the second floor to find the main living spaces, including a comfortable sitting area with a TV for relaxing after a day outdoors. The open-concept kitchen’s high-end appliances make cooking a breeze while visiting with friends perched along the 7-stool breakfast bar. There’s plenty of seating inside at the dining table’s 3 long benches and 2 chairs or dine alfresco at the covered balcony’s 2 patio tables. When night falls, retire to the 2 guest bedrooms with king beds and private bathrooms on this level. On the top floor, 2 guest bedrooms with king beds share a balcony with Gulf views, and there are 2 bunk rooms with queen-over-queen beds. A kitchen, living area with a queen sleeper sofa and 1 guest bedroom with a king bed are in the private Carriage House. Whake Up is the perfect setting for a delightful Seagrove Beach adventure. Leisurely explore with 9 complimentary adult bikes, a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle, and parking for 6 vehicles. For private beach access, follow the wooden boardwalk to the right of the driveway. Beachside Drive Public Beach Access and Walton Dunes Public Beach Access are also nearby. Book today!
